description: Wednesday 19:40: Hattie Moore, the Orange Mound Community Garden's coordinator, emails Reggie, in a new thread, a photo of the crew's bench sketch with her red correction: the slats' 1/4 x 2 flat bar struck through and 3/16 x 2 written under it, 'lighter please - HM 12/9'. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Wednesday 20:05: Darnell asks him to bring his big cooler on Saturday (his own has a cracked lid), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced). Wednesday 21:30: Calvin Reed asks him to look at his trailer hitch this weekend (it rattles), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced).

filesystem.description: The attachment of Hattie Moore (Orange Mound Community Garden)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. Hattie Moore's correction on the bench sketch: the slats in 3/16 x 2 flat bar.

silent.description: Hattie Moore (Orange Mound Community Garden) emails Reggie a picture. Hattie Moore's correction on the bench sketch: the slats in 3/16 x 2 flat bar.
A WhatsApp message lands in Reggie's chat with Darnell Washington.

row.text: Can you bring your big cooler Saturday? Mine's got a crack in the lid.

silent.description: A WhatsApp message lands in Reggie's chat with Calvin Reed.

row.text: Coach, can you look at my trailer hitch this weekend? It's rattling bad.
